providers.description: Frete.com is the Brazilian road-freight technology group formed in January 2023 when CargoX merged with Fretebras and FretePago, becoming Latin America's largest freight-matching platform and one of Brazil's logistics unicorns after a US$200M round led by SoftBank and Tencent. The group operates three consumer-facing brands: Fretebras, the freight marketplace that connects shippers and carriers with autonomous truck drivers; CargoX Brasil, which bundles working-capital credit, cargo insurance, document issuance and truck tracking for trucking companies; and FretePago, a fintech offering a digital account and freight payment rails for drivers and fleets. It also acquired Rotas Brasil for route mapping and toll pricing. The platform applies machine learning to freight matching, fraud and cargo-theft prevention, and pricing intelligence. Frete.com does not currently publish a public developer portal or machine-readable API contract; the Fretebras integration API is reached through partner and ERP/TMS channels rather than an open reference.

providers.name: HungryPanda
providers.description: HungryPanda (熊猫外卖) is the largest Asian food delivery platform serving overseas Chinese communities, founded in Nottingham, UK in 2017 and headquartered in London. It operates a marketplace app, a rider delivery network, the Panda Fresh Asian grocery e-commerce platform and the VouchersPanda lifestyle-deals platform across more than 80 cities in ten countries (UK, France, Italy, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea and Singapore). Its API surface is a regionally partitioned merchant/partner ordering platform used by POS and middleware integrators — Deliverect, Otter, Neopos, Hubster, Menusifu, Easy Cloud and Redcat — to inject HungryPanda orders into a restaurant point of sale, push order-status updates back, and sync menus. Integration credentials (App Key, Secret Key, ShopID) are issued by HungryPanda on a partner basis; there is no public developer portal, no published specification and no self-service sign-up.

providers.name: 2ULaundry
providers.description: 2ULaundry is a laundry and dry cleaning pickup-and-delivery service headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina and backed by Techstars. Customers schedule pickups through a mobile app, leave color-coded bags at their door, and receive cleaned items back within one to two business days. Services include residential wash-and-fold, delicate garment care, dry cleaning, and household linens, plus commercial laundry solutions for Airbnbs, spas, gyms, salons, and healthcare facilities. The company operates its own processing facilities and a fleet-based delivery network across its Southeast US markets. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from the Techstars portfolio and enriched; 2ULaundry is a consumer service company and publishes no public developer API.

providers.name: Anvyl
providers.description: Anvyl is a supply chain and production management platform (a "Production Hub") for consumer-brand and e-commerce companies, connecting brands with their suppliers to manage the purchase-order and manufacturing lifecycle in one place: issuing and tracking purchase orders, coordinating production milestones and tasks, managing suppliers and SKUs/products, and monitoring inbound shipments and logistics. Anvyl was acquired by Sage and now operates under the Sage umbrella. It exposes a token-authenticated REST API (api.anvyl.com/api/v1) documented via Stoplight, with resources such as purchase orders. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Anvyl's live public developer surface.

providers.name: Emirates SkyCargo
providers.description: Emirates SkyCargo is the air cargo division of Emirates Airline, headquartered at Dubai International Airport in the United Arab Emirates, moving general freight, pharmaceuticals, perishables, live animals, valuables, mail and courier traffic across a network of more than 140 destinations on six continents using both freighters and passenger-aircraft bellyhold capacity. In the shipment chain it is the airborne carrier leg sitting between the freight forwarder and the ground handler, and it books almost exclusively through intermediaries rather than shippers directly. Its API posture is advertised but not published: Emirates SkyCargo states on its own Digital Booking Channels page that it offers "a direct API connection to your in-house system" covering booking creation, amendments, cancellations and track and trace, yet there is no developer portal, no API reference, no OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document, no base URL and no self-serve signup anywhere on skycargo.com. Access is obtained only by emailing SkyCargoAPISupport@emirates.com to negotiate a host-to-host connection, by integrating through the CargoWise transport management system, by submitting Freight Forwarding Requests over EDI, or by booking through the WebCargo, CargoAi, Pelicargo and cargo.one marketplaces, which themselves require IATA/CASS accreditation. The one standard the organization documents on its own surface is IATA e-AWB: agents must sign the IATA Multilateral e-AWB Agreement before submitting FWB and FHL cargo messages over EDI messaging. This is an EDI-and-bilateral-integration carrier with a customer-contract portal veneer, not a public API provider.

providers.name: Nowlun Holding Corp.
providers.description: Nowlun is a digital freight-forwarding platform serving the Middle East and North Africa that lets businesses compare instant ocean-freight quotes from 30+ shipping lines, book FCL and bulk sea shipments, arrange inland trucking to and from ports, track cargo through transit, and handle customs clearance. Beyond its shipper-facing web application, Nowlun operates a live, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://nowlun.com/mcp, secured with RFC 8414 authorization-server and RFC 9728 protected-resource discovery (Authorization Code + PKCE, "mcp" scope). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Rinse
providers.description: Rinse is a laundry and dry cleaning delivery service that picks up customers' clothes from home, professionally cleans them, and returns them on a recurring or one-off schedule. It runs a wash & fold and dry cleaning model in which uniformed valets handle evening pickup and delivery (typically 7pm-10pm) across major U.S. metros including the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington D.C., Boston, Seattle, and Austin, plus Toronto. Rinse emphasizes convenience, garment care, sustainability, and employing its valets as W-2 employees with benefits. The company is backed by Partech and is tracked in the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Rinse publishes a consumer web and mobile product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

providers.name: Souco
providers.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

providers.name: Goodr
providers.description: Goodr is an Atlanta-based sustainable surplus food management and hunger-relief logistics company founded in 2016 by Jasmine Crowe-Houston. Goodr helps businesses divert edible and inedible food waste from landfills by scheduling pickups, donating surplus edible food to local nonprofits, and providing donors with the tax deductions and impact reporting tied to those donations. Alongside its food-waste solutions, Goodr runs hunger-relief programs including pop-up grocery markets, meal delivery, student snackpacks, and community grocery stores. The company reports more than 30 million meals served and 4 million pounds of food diverted from landfills for enterprise partners such as Amazon, Google, NASA, and Fulton County. Goodr operates through a partner portal rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks its public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Arvist
providers.description: Arvist AI is a Chicago-based computer-vision platform for warehouse and supply-chain operations that turns existing cameras, scanners, and WMS/ERP data into automated quality control, safety and compliance monitoring, load verification, inbound shipment inspection, and freight-claims management. The system deploys on-premise edge servers, integrates with 80+ leading WMS and ERP platforms without new hardware, and detects damage, defects, unsafe behavior, and outbound shipping errors in real time. Backed by Techstars, Arvist is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I compliant. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from Arvist's public web surface; the company currently publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI.

providers.name: xChange
providers.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

providers.name: Flock Freight
providers.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

providers.name: US Foods
providers.description: US Foods is one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, serving restaurants, healthcare facilities, hospitality businesses, government institutions, and educational facilities. As a Fortune 500 company, US Foods operates a national distribution network with over 70 distribution centers and serves approximately 250,000 customers. The company's digital platform includes the MOXe eCommerce application for ordering and business management, EDI integration for B2B transactions, and a supplier PIM system for product data synchronization. US Foods has undergone significant digital transformation building a data mesh architecture on Apache Kafka, MongoDB, and cloud platforms to support its eCommerce and supply chain operations.

providers.name: Clutter
providers.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

providers.name: Pango
providers.description: Pango is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered operating system for e-commerce post-purchase and logistics operations. The platform positions itself as an "agentic OS" — autonomous AI agents that handle back-office logistics tasks — and consolidates multi-carrier delivery management, checkout delivery options, branded order tracking, and returns processing into a single unified system. Pango advertises multi-carrier orchestration across 100+ shipping providers with AI-powered routing and rate optimization, self-service return portals with automated approvals, warehouse pick-and-pack automation, and AI agents that resolve exceptions and automate workflows. It integrates with major commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce, NetSuite) and 100+ carrier, WMS, marketing, and support partners. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass the company markets an "API-first architecture" but publishes no public developer documentation, API reference, OpenAPI spec, or SDK.

providers.name: SmartHop
providers.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

providers.name: OZON.ru
providers.description: OZON is one of Russia's largest e-commerce marketplaces, offering retail across electronics, apparel, groceries, and more, plus its own logistics and fulfillment network (FBO/FBS). For developers, OZON exposes the OZON Seller API, a POST-based RPC-over-HTTP JSON API at https://api-seller.ozon.ru that lets marketplace sellers manage products, prices, stock, warehouses, orders, returns, analytics, and finances programmatically. Authentication uses two headers, a numeric Client-Id and a secret Api-Key issued in the seller cabinet. OZON was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from live probes of its API host and public developer documentation.

providers.name: Kabal
providers.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

providers.name: Parcel Monitor
providers.description: Global parcel tracking REST API aggregating real-time tracking data from 1,000+ carriers worldwide, enabling e-commerce shipment visibility, delivery analytics, and webhook-driven notifications across 170+ countries.

providers.name: Mercado Libre
providers.description: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce marketplace in Latin America with adjacent fintech (Mercado Pago), logistics (Mercado Envios), and ads businesses. The developer platform exposes REST APIs for items, orders, shipments, users, payments, and seller tooling.

providers.name: Cogoport
providers.description: Cogoport is a global logistics and supply chain platform offering freight booking, customs, trade finance, and supply chain visibility for businesses across ocean, air, and inland transport. It provides ocean (FCL and LCL) and air freight booking with real-time rate discovery, customs clearance and compliance support, trade finance including invoice financing and pay-later solutions, end-to-end shipment tracking, and logistics tools such as an HS Code Finder, container trackers, and shipping cost calculators. Cogoport is backed by Accel and headquartered in India, serving importers and exporters worldwide.

providers.name: Defense Logistics Agency
providers.description: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is the U.S. Department of Defense combat support agency that manages a global supply chain spanning roughly five million items in nine supply chains plus storage, distribution, fuel, construction, and disposition missions. DLA operates an extensive catalog of business applications used by suppliers, the military services, and federal partners. Most DLA applications require account registration and operate behind authentication; public-facing surfaces include the DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS), the DLA Disposition Services storefront, the FedMall procurement marketplace, and federated logistics search tools.

providers.name: TemperPack
providers.description: TemperPack is a Richmond, Virginia based sustainable packaging manufacturer, founded in 2015 and a Certified B Corporation, that designs and manufactures curbside recyclable and compostable alternatives to expanded polystyrene (EPS) and single-use plastic for cold chain and protective shipping. Its three material platforms are ClimaCell, a starch-and-paper thermal liner for cold chain shipments; Green Cell Foam, a certified compostable starch-based insulation with EPS-level performance; and WaveKraft, paper-based cushioning produced on demand. Products span cushioning, mailers, qualified shippers and stock shippers, serving life sciences, food and beverage, pet and veterinary, wine, and packaging distribution customers from ISO 9001:2015 certified plants in Richmond VA, Lansing MI and Las Vegas NV, with in-house ISTA thermal and mechanical testing at its Proving Ground lab. TemperPack operates a customer portal for order tracking, thermal testing results, billing and WaveKraft analytics, and an e-commerce store, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition or developer portal as of August 2026.

providers.name: Barn2Door
providers.description: Barn2Door is a Seattle-based commerce and business-management platform purpose-built for independent farmers and local food producers. It gives farms an online store, order and subscription management, inventory tracking, delivery and pickup logistics, integrated payments, and built-in marketing and customer-relationship tools, consolidating the systems a farm needs to sell direct-to-consumer and wholesale into a single dashboard. Barn2Door connects to partners including Mailchimp, QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Avalara, Shippo, Routific, Squarespace, and Facebook, but does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal at this time.

providers.name: Boxbee
providers.description: Boxbee is an on-demand storage and reusable moving-box rental service operating across California, including the San Francisco Bay Area, San Jose, Oakland, Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, and San Diego. It offers valet pickup-and-delivery storage, rentable reusable plastic moving crates for consumers and businesses, and an online inventory system for managing stored items. Boxbee originated as a 500 Startups and Google Ventures-backed app-based valet self-storage startup founded in 2012; after the by-the-box operation was sold, the brand continued as a regional storage and moving-supply provider. No public API or developer program is currently published.

providers.name: CloudTrucks
providers.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

providers.name: HUNGRY
providers.description: HUNGRY (Hungry Marketplace, Inc.) is an Arlington, Virginia workplace food platform that connects corporate clients to a curated network of independent chefs and local restaurants. Founded in 2016 by Jeff Grass, Eman Pahlavani and Shy Pahlevani, it operates four product lines — office catering, Group Order individual meal pre-ordering, live events and chef pop-ups, and snacks and pantry — plus HUNGRY Last Mile, its own delivery and logistics arm. The platform runs its own admin, chef/food-partner dashboard, client admin dashboard, ops captain app and consumer ordering marketplace across 24 US cities and, following the February 2026 merger with Toronto-based hungerhub, more than ten Canadian markets. Earlier acquisitions include NatureBox and Garten. HUNGRY publishes no public developer program: the backing API at api.tryhungry.com is a private first-party service for its own web and mobile clients, and no OpenAPI, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI, SDK or partner API reference is published anywhere on its public surface. The company does publish a dated, public engineering release-notes site, which is the only machine-adjacent technical artifact it makes available.

providers.name: Melonn
providers.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

providers.name: Fleetmatics
providers.description: Fleetmatics was a fleet management, telematics, and GPS vehicle tracking SaaS company whose Reveal platform tracked commercial vehicles, drivers, and mobile assets for small and mid-sized fleets. Founded in Dublin and later headquartered in Massachusetts, Fleetmatics IPO'd on the NYSE in 2012 and was acquired by Verizon in 2016 for about USD 2.4 billion, becoming the core of Verizon Connect. Its Reveal platform exposes a documented REST API and webhook suite - the Fleetmatics Integration Manager (FIM) / Reveal Integration Services APIs - covering vehicles, drivers, GPS positions and history, trips and segments, driver status and safety, hours-of-service logbooks, geofences (places), groups, and non-powered asset tracking. The API gateway still runs on Fleetmatics-branded hosts (fim.api.us.fleetmatics.com); access is gated to Reveal customers and approved integration partners who request Integration Manager and Reveal REST credentials before calling the documented endpoints. The Fleetmatics brand now redirects to Verizon Connect.

providers.name: Ontruck
providers.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe. Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Mottu
providers.description: Mottu is the leading motorcycle-rental ecosystem in Latin America, founded in 2020 in Sao Paulo, Brazil by Rubens Zanelatto. It rents motorcycles to gig and delivery couriers who lack access to traditional credit, bundling insurance, maintenance, 24-hour support and financial services (Mottu Pay) so workers can earn income through food delivery, e-commerce and last-mile logistics. Mottu has verticalized the value chain, running its own assembly line, parts and service network, and fleet-management software, and offers white-labeled last-mile delivery (Mottu Entregas) to more than 1,000 retailers across 100+ cities in Brazil and Mexico. Backed by QED Investors, Mottu has raised over US$150M. It operates as a consumer and B2B mobility/fintech app and does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: OSARO
providers.description: OSARO is a San Francisco-based industrial AI company that builds machine-learning software for warehouse and fulfillment robotics. Its SightWorks perception platform and AutoModel learning system let industrial robot arms perceive, grasp and place highly variable goods without per-SKU pre-training, 3D object models or fixed programming, powering piece picking, robotic bagging, kitting and mixed-case depalletizing in production deployments across five countries. OSARO sells complete robotic work cells and licenses its perception software to robot makers and system integrators, wrapping deployments in its HyperCare support program. The company publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; integration with customer estates (WMS/WCS, conveyors, ASRS, AMRs) is delivered as a professional-services engagement through OSARO and its integrator partners rather than through a self-serve API.

providers.name: Terminal Logistics
providers.description: Terminal Industries (Terminal Logistics) is the company behind the Terminal Yard Operating System (YOS), an AI-native, fully-integrated platform for yard operations across logistics and supply chain. It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

providers.name: Ambi Robotics
providers.description: Ambi Robotics is a Berkeley, California AI robotics company building parcel-sortation and induction robots for ecommerce, postal, and logistics workflows. Founded in 2018 as Ambidextrous Laboratories — a spin-out of UC Berkeley's Dex-Net Project led by Ken Goldberg — by Jeff Mahler (CTO), Stephen McKinley, David Gealy, and Matt Matl, with Jim Liefer (ex-Walmart, ex-UPS) as CEO. Its flagship products are AmbiSort A-Series (sort-to-sack small parcel sorting), AmbiSort B-Series (sort-to-gaylord parcel induction for middle-mile and reverse logistics), AmbiStack (mixed-case stacking for inbound and outbound), and AmbiVision (3D dimensioning, OCR, defect detection, and visual quality inspection). All robots run AmbiOS, the company's cloud-native "operating system for physical intelligence," comprising the AI Skill Suite (Sort, Stack, Kit, Pack, Induct apps), the PRIME-1 foundation model trained on millions of real-world operations, AmbiVision perception, AmbiAccess fleet management dashboard with heat maps and remote support, and a Sim2Real training pipeline that compresses model training by up to 10,000x. Ambi Robotics' primary commercial deployment is a $23 million expansion with Pitney Bowes, with AmbiSort A-Series and B-Series systems deployed across Pitney Bowes ecommerce hubs in the US (including the Stockton, CA hub that nearly doubled local-direct-delivery throughput in the 2021 peak holiday season, and middle-mile B-Series systems that sorted more than 3 million parcels within four months of deployment). Ambi Robotics does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for AmbiOS, AmbiSort, AmbiStack, or PRIME-1; integration with customer WMS/WES systems is performed by Ambi's solutions team. The company's public GitHub org primarily contains forks of infrastructure tooling (Ray, trimesh, FCL, EIPScanner, tinygltf, rapier, jszmq, CVXPYgen, mongoose-delete) and internal CI/CD workflow utilities — no published API spec, SDK package, or developer documentation.

providers.name: CLUBZERO
providers.description: CLUBZERO (CLUBZERØ) is a London-based reuse system administrator helping the food and beverage industry transition from single-use to reusable packaging. Its AI-powered platform serializes every reusable item with a GS1-standard QR, RFID, or barcode identifier, then coordinates the drop points, collection, washing, and redistribution logistics that keep packaging in circulation across on-trade, online delivery, and retail channels. CLUBZERO reports 95-98% return rates and 3.3M+ packaging rotations, running reuse programs for brands including McDonald's, Nestlé, Aramark, Compass Group, Just Eat, and the Wimbledon Championships. Backed by Seedcamp and added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public API surface is currently documented.

providers.name: Freshket
providers.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

providers.name: Tenkara
providers.description: Tenkara is an AI-powered operations and supply chain platform for material manufacturers across food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, beverages, and OTC products. The platform automates 75+ workflows spanning supplier sourcing and qualification, procurement, freight and logistics booking, order tracking, and compliance documentation (COA, SDS, and audit records), helping manufacturers find better suppliers faster, prevent delays, and run more efficient operations. Tenkara is backed by True Ventures.

providers.name: Timberhub
providers.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Vector.ai
providers.description: Vector.ai, now operating as Raft (raft.ai), is an AI-powered logistics automation platform for freight forwarders, customs brokers, and trade finance teams. The Raft Intelligence Engine layers organization data, contextual LLMs, orchestration, and specialized governed agents to automate document processing, invoice matching, data extraction, and exception handling across supply chain operations, reporting 20M+ tasks completed by AI agents and 5M+ shipments processed annually. Raft publishes no public developer API; the platform is an enterprise application that integrates with customers' TMS and ERP systems.

providers.name: YQN
providers.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

providers.name: Cardinal Health
providers.description: Cardinal Health is a Fortune 15 global integrated healthcare services and products company that provides pharmaceutical distribution, medical-surgical product distribution, and customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. Cardinal Health does not publish a public developer portal, but it exchanges high volumes of B2B trading data with customers and suppliers via standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 810, 855, 856, 846, 832, 867) over AS2, SFTP, and private API channels. Third-party EDI platforms such as Orderful, Crossfire, SPS Commerce, Zenbridge, DataTrans, Alluvia, ConnectPointz, and Spark Shipping offer managed connectors into Cardinal Health for order-to-cash, inventory, and supply-chain automation.

providers.name: Partsimony
providers.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: Silq
providers.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

providers.name: Expedock
providers.description: Expedock is a digital business process outsourcing (BPO) and document-automation company for the logistics and freight-forwarding industry. It pairs AI-powered document automation products (FCL/LCL accounts-payable automation, monthly statement automation, and commercial invoice and packing-list data entry) with tech-enabled remote teams supported by operations managers and QA specialists. Freight forwarders, 3PLs, and supply-chain operators use Expedock to digitize shipping documents, automate back-office workflows, and scale operations without scaling headcount. Customers include Maersk, Gebrueder Weiss, and large shippers such as Nike, Adidas, Coca-Cola, and Shell. Expedock is backed by Insight Partners. The company operates a Digital BPO offering and document-automation product suite; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

providers.name: Riff
providers.description: Riff is an Oslo, Norway based enterprise software company building AI agents for supply chain, procurement, planning, and logistics operations. Its agents automate repetitive back-office work such as chasing supplier order confirmations, updating order and delivery status, matching invoices, and monitoring deliveries, while keeping actions deterministic, auditable, and team-controlled rather than purely generative. Riff integrates non-disruptively with existing ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Infor, and Microsoft, is EU-based with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned and GDPR compliant data handling, and was founded by veterans of Cognite. The company raised a $16M Series A backed by Northzone and other investors. Riff has no public developer or API program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: China Southern Air Logistics
providers.description: China Southern Air Logistics Co., Ltd. (南航物流, CSAL) is the air cargo and logistics arm of China Southern Airlines, established in December 2018 and headquartered in Guangzhou. It combines the airline's freighter fleet with passenger belly capacity into an integrated air logistics network, and sells express (CZ Speed), standard, special cargo, whole-aircraft charter, intermodal truck and door-to-door products through its Tang (唐翼) online cargo system at cargo.csair.com, where agents and shippers book capacity, query freight rates, track air waybills, manage dangerous-goods accounts and request invoices. As of this profile the company publishes no developer program, no public API reference and no machine-readable specification; system-to-system integration is arranged bilaterally with agents and forwarders.

providers.name: Nowports
providers.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

providers.name: Freterium
providers.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

providers.name: Leta
providers.description: Leta is a pan-African logistics technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya, with operations across Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa. Leta builds an AI-driven delivery management platform that helps businesses move goods cheaper and faster while minimising climate impact: route optimization, automated dispatch and broadcast, live GPS track-and-trace, payment on delivery, fleet management, and delivery analytics. The platform is delivered as logistics SaaS plus on-demand and dedicated rider services, including an M-PESA business mini-app, and serves e-commerce, third-party logistics and courier, food and beverage, retail and consumer goods, and pharmacy and healthcare delivery operators. Leta is backed by Speedinvest.

providers.name: Odeko
providers.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

providers.name: AutoTrac
providers.description: AutoTrac is a Brazilian fleet management and vehicle tracking technology company with over 30 years of experience. As the national market leader, AutoTrac provides satellite and cellular fleet tracking solutions, real-time telemetry, driver journey management, and management intelligence platforms for logistics, agriculture, maritime, and insurance sectors. The company operates its own terrestrial satellite communication station and data center for nationwide coverage.

providers.name: Delek US Holdings
providers.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK) is a diversified downstream energy company headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee with assets in petroleum refining, logistics, asphalt operations, renewable fuels, and convenience store retailing. Delek operates four refineries in Tyler and Big Spring (Texas), El Dorado (Arkansas), and Krotz Springs (Louisiana) with combined crude throughput capacity of roughly 302,000 barrels per day. Logistics assets are operated through Delek Logistics Partners (NYSE: DKL). The company provides investor relations and ESG reporting on its public website but does not publish a developer API; partner integrations occur through industry-standard EDI, terminal automation, and ticketing systems.

providers.name: Mienvío
providers.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

providers.name: Buncha
providers.description: Buncha is a scheduled neighborhood grocery delivery service operating across Minnesota and Michigan. Customers shop online from local partner retailers and receive their orders on set weekly routes, with a single refrigerated van consolidating multiple neighbors' orders into one trip for a $3.45 flat delivery fee. Professional personal shoppers hand-pick items into insulated bags, and the aggregated-route model is positioned to cut delivery CO2 emissions by up to 80% versus on-demand services. Buncha is offered through iOS and Android consumer apps and is backed by Foundry Group and Techstars. It is currently a consumer product with no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Pallet
providers.description: Pallet builds an AI-powered logistics workforce: autonomous AI agents that automate supply chain operations for freight brokerages, freight forwarders, FTL and LTL carriers, warehouses, and shippers. Its agents handle end-to-end workflows from quoting through order entry, track-and-trace, billing, and customer service, integrating with existing TMS, WMS, email, and legacy applications. The Atlas product surfaces revenue opportunities across freight operations. Pallet is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Portex
providers.description: Portex is a freight procurement and management platform that replaces the emails, spreadsheets, and PDFs of traditional freight quoting with a single collaborative workspace. Shippers, brokers, carriers, and forwarders use Portex to create, send, receive, compare, and award freight quotes up to 90% faster, centralize shipment documents and tracking, chat with carriers, and analyze freight spend for cost-saving recommendations. Founded by Brittany Ennix (previously Uber and Flexport) and backed by Cowboy Ventures, Portex is a seed-stage logistics technology company. As of this profile the platform is delivered as a hosted web application at portexpro.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tutor Intelligence
providers.description: Tutor Intelligence builds AI-powered robotic workers for industrial and logistics operations, delivered as robots-as-a-service. Its flagship Cassie palletizing robot handles material-handling tasks — palletizing, depalletizing, and case picking — in warehouses and factories without facility retrofits, and a humanoid robot, Sonny, is slated for late 2026. The company pairs on-robot autonomy with a human-in-the-loop teleoperation and data model, priced per robot-hour with no long-term contracts, and is backed by Union Square Ventures. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this profiling; the company's public GitHub organization hosts internal tooling and open-source forks rather than a first-party product API.

providers.name: Deposco
providers.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

providers.name: Dianxiaomi
providers.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

providers.name: GoodShip
providers.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform for shippers, brokers, and asset-based carriers. It unifies TMS tender, contract-award, and location data, enriches it with real-time market rates, and layers AI-assisted bid analysis (via its Laney AI transportation analyst), lane- and carrier-level performance analytics, carrier scorecards, and in-app collaboration on top. Teams run mini-bids and full-network RFPs, benchmark spend against the market, and take corrective action without dedicated developer resources. Plug-and-play with major transportation management systems; backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and serving US and Canadian operations.

providers.name: Nabu
providers.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

providers.name: Bellhops
providers.description: Bellhops (branded as Bellhop) is a US technology-enabled moving-services company that operates an online booking platform for residential and commercial relocations. Customers get a free estimate and reserve local moves, long-distance relocations, hourly moving labor, packing help, and last-minute moves with no money down, then manage their reservation through an online dashboard staffed by background-checked movers. The company reports more than 300,000 completed moves and a 4.8/5 average rating across 20,000+ reviews. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and Initialized Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Bellhops is a consumer-facing service with no publicly documented API, developer portal, or programmatic integration surface as of this profile.

providers.name: Club Feast
providers.description: Club Feast is a technology-enabled restaurant delivery and corporate catering company founded in 2020 by Atallah Atallah, Ghazi Atallah, and Chris Miao. It began as a subscription-based consumer meal service delivering signature dishes from neighborhood restaurants at deep discounts through a pre-order, scheduled batch-delivery model, and has since focused on corporate catering, group meal ordering with individual customization, event catering, and managed office pantry services for teams. Club Feast handles restaurant partnerships, menu curation, driver logistics, and delivery while employees select meals through its web app. The company raised seed funding led by General Catalyst and operates primarily in the San Francisco Bay Area. Club Feast does not currently publish a public developer API, portal, or specification; this profile tracks its company identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Harbor Lab
providers.description: Harbor Lab is an AI-powered port cost and disbursement account (DA) management platform for the maritime industry, headquartered in Athens, Greece. Its cloud software helps shipowners, ship managers, charterers, and port agents manage port calls, validate and approve disbursement accounts, benchmark and negotiate port service pricing across a marketplace of thousands of port service providers, and automate payment and settlement — improving operational efficiency, digitizing the process, and delivering cost transparency across port cost management. The company is backed by Speedinvest, VentureFriends, Atomico, and others. As of this profile Harbor Lab exposes a web dashboard product only; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Medzoomer
providers.description: Medzoomer is an on-demand prescription delivery platform that connects pharmacies, healthcare providers, and patients through a secure, HIPAA-compliant network of verified couriers. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Tampa, Florida, the company handles last-mile medication logistics, including controlled substances (Schedule II-V), with tamper-evident packaging, FDA/TSA-approved envelopes, and real-time order tracking. Pharmacies and couriers operate through dedicated web and mobile applications, and the platform is backed by Techstars, UnitedHealthcare Accelerator, and other investors. Medzoomer operates a private pharmacy integration API but publishes no public developer documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Packhelp
providers.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

providers.name: EAT Club
providers.description: EAT Club is a corporate meal-delivery platform founded in 2010 in Redwood City, California by Kevin Yang and Rodrigo Santibanez, built around the idea of a "virtual cafeteria" for offices with no on-site dining. Instead of tray-style catering, each employee picks an individually packaged meal from a rotating daily menu produced by EAT Club's own kitchens and restaurant partners, and every order for a building arrives in one synchronized delivery. The company markets the program as an employee lunch benefit and reports 21 million meals delivered to roughly 1,145 companies across nine cities. Compass Group USA acquired EAT Club in October 2020 and folded its ordering, production and delivery technology into Compass Digital Labs, where it now underpins workplace, education and healthcare dining accounts across the US and Canada. The consumer-facing product is a React ordering app served from www.eatclub.com; EAT Club publishes no developer program, no API reference, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind.

providers.name: Nuvocargo
providers.description: Nuvocargo is an AI-powered freight-management platform for North American truckload logistics, focused on the US-Mexico-Canada cross-border corridor. Its "Nuvo AI" system coordinates a network of specialized agents (quoting, negotiation, booking, dispatch, tracking, exception handling, audit, and payment) to automate the freight load lifecycle, and it pairs that software with licensed freight brokerage, managed transportation, and customs-brokerage services. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Homebrew and QED Investors. As of this enrichment pass Nuvocargo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; onboarding is contact-gated ("zero-integration" pilots), so this profile captures the company identity, legal/resource surface, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Coco Robotics
providers.description: Coco Robotics is a Santa Monica, California urban robotics company operating a fleet of zero-emission, remotely-supervised sidewalk delivery robots ("Cocobots") for last-mile food, grocery and retail delivery. Merchants do not integrate with Coco directly: Coco is consumed as a delivery service provider through Uber Eats, DoorDash, Wolt and Olo Dispatch, and the company publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or webhooks of its own. Its public software surface is limited to a marketing site, a customer order-tracking web app, and a GitHub organization of forked ROS and infrastructure tooling.

providers.name: Datakrew
providers.description: Datakrew is a Singapore-based deep-tech company, a spin-off from NTU Singapore supported by Enterprise Singapore, building EV battery intelligence, fleet management, and AI-driven telematics for logistics and delivery, public transport, vehicle OEMs, rental/leasing and shared mobility operators, and mining and construction fleets. Its integrated hardware, software, and AI stack spans the OxRed (MyFleet) fleet-management and intelligence platform, OxRed Lens camera-based visualization telematics, OxRed AutoCert automated certification and compliance, GuardianAI driver-safety and collision-warning analytics, the Ask OX natural-language fleet assistant, and the ITUS Max and ITUS AutoScan edge terminals for telemetry, CAN-bus integration, and vehicle diagnostics, all aimed at optimizing battery health, safety, and operational efficiency.

providers.name: Kodiak AI
providers.description: Kodiak AI, Inc. (formerly Kodiak Robotics) is a Mountain View, California company building the Kodiak Driver, an AI-powered ground autonomy system for driverless trucking and defense vehicles. Founded in April 2018 by Don Burnette, Kodiak develops a purpose-built autonomous driving stack — sensor pods, 4D radar, sparse maps, and fallback systems — that integrates into third-party driving platforms rather than shipping a vehicle of its own. The company runs commercial driverless freight lanes in Texas, Oklahoma, Ohio and Indiana with partners including Atlas Energy Solutions, Maersk, Martin Brower, Roehl Transport, JB Hunt and Werner, and it adapts the same driver to defense and industrial missions with General Dynamics Land Systems, Textron Systems and the US Army. Kodiak raised a $125M Series B in 2021 with Lightspeed Venture Partners, Battery Ventures, CRV, SIP Global Partners and others participating, and became a public company through a business combination with Ares Acquisition Corporation II. Kodiak publishes a corporate web presence, a news/RSS feed and an llms.txt for agents, but does not currently operate a public developer program, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: SpartanNash
providers.description: SpartanNash is a Byron Center, Michigan food solutions company that operates as both a wholesale grocery distributor and a retail grocer. Its wholesale segment supplies roughly 2,100 independent retail locations, national accounts and e-commerce partners from a network of distribution centers, and through its MDV business it is the leading distributor of grocery products to United States military commissaries and exchanges worldwide. Its retail segment operates roughly 200 corporate-owned supermarkets under banners including Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets, D&W Fresh Market, VG's Grocery, Dan's Supermarket, Family Fresh Market, Needler's Fresh Market, Fresh City Market, Forest Hills Foods and Supermercado Nuestra Familia, alongside pharmacy and fuel centers. Formed by the 2013 merger of Spartan Stores and Nash Finch, the company traded on Nasdaq as SPTN until C&S Wholesale Grocers completed its acquisition of SpartanNash on September 22, 2025; SpartanNash now operates as part of C&S and its corporate web properties are progressively being folded into cswg.com. SpartanNash publishes no public developer program, API documentation or machine-readable API contract; supplier and customer system integration is transacted over EDI through trading-partner onboarding rather than a public API.

providers.name: Stuf Storage
providers.description: Stuf is a next-generation, tech-enabled self-storage operator that partners with commercial real estate owners to convert underutilized space — basements, garages and retail vacancies — into modern neighborhood storage facilities. Stuf runs 36 facilities across seven US metros (New York City, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Atlanta, Boston and Washington, DC). Members search and book units online, pay month-to-month with all-inclusive pricing and no hidden fees, and open facility doors with a digital key issued through the Stuf Member Dashboard. Stuf publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract; the one machine-readable surface it does serve is a substantial, actively maintained llms.txt at https://www.stufstorage.com/llms.txt, alongside an AI-crawler-permissive robots.txt.

providers.name: Verve Motion
providers.description: Verve Motion is a wearable robotics company spun out of the Harvard Biodesign Lab that builds SafeLift, a soft powered exosuit for industrial workers who lift repetitively. Inertial sensors woven into the suit detect lifting motion and trigger assistive force that the company says takes up to 40% of the strain off a worker's back, while Verve Logic — its cloud platform — collects the resulting movement data and reports ergonomic risk, unsafe-posture trends and exosuit utilization to safety managers. SafeLift is sold as a subscription bundling the exosuit, the Verve Logic data portal and Verve Care support, and is distributed in part through partners such as HexArmor. Verve Motion publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification; the Verve Logic portal at logic.vervemotion.com is a customer-only single-page application that disallows crawling in robots.txt.

providers.name: Cargolux
providers.description: Cargolux Airlines International S.A. is Europe's largest all-cargo airline, headquartered at Luxembourg Findel Airport in Luxembourg and operating a global Boeing 747 freighter network under IATA designator CV and air waybill prefix 172 (with Cargolux Italia on prefix 356). In the logistics chain Cargolux is the main-leg air carrier: it sells capacity to freight forwarders and general sales agents rather than to shippers, hands cargo to terminal and ground handling operators such as its Luxcargo Handling subsidiary, and files customs and security data on behalf of the contracted forwarder. Its API posture is honestly a customer-contract one. Cargolux publishes no developer portal and no machine-readable contract of any kind — developer.cargolux.com, developers.cargolux.com and docs.cargolux.com do not resolve, and /developers, /api, /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /api-docs and /.well-known/ all return 404 on www.cargolux.com. The only public self-service surfaces are HTML: a track-and-trace widget and a flight scheduler on the marketing site, plus a login-walled Customer Portal at my.cargolux.com. A real quote-and- booking API exists, but it is a bilateral, commercially negotiated forwarder interface — piloted with Kuehne+Nagel in 2021 and extended to DB Schenker — with no published reference, and it is complemented by indirect distribution through the cargo.one, CargoAi and WebCargo by Freightos marketplaces. Underneath, Cargolux runs IBS Software's iCargo SaaS cargo management system and holds a large minority stake in Luxembourg's CHAMP Cargosystems, whose developer.champ.aero portal is the developer surface Cargolux's ecosystem actually reads — CHAMP's, not Cargolux's. IATA e-AWB "Single Process" is documented; no IATA ONE Record or Cargo-XML publication was found.

providers.name: Juxta
providers.description: Juxta is a San Francisco positioning-technology company building a hardware-free Universal Positioning System (UPS) that delivers real-time indoor and outdoor tracking for people, assets, and robots with sub-meter accuracy indoors and roughly 3-meter accuracy outdoors. Rather than relying on satellites, beacons, or cameras, Juxta uses the inertial (IMU) sensors already present in mobile devices, robots, and machinery combined with machine-learning "synthetic fingerprinting" to map and track subjects in GPS-denied environments such as warehouses, hospitals, underground facilities, and battlefields. Its drag-and-drop deployment ingests a floorplan, satellite image, or CAD file and goes live in hours, priced by mapped area and assets tracked. Juxta serves defense, logistics and robotics, and healthcare, and is backed by Y Combinator and other early-stage investors. Access today is through a partner portal and booked demo; no public developer API is documented.

providers.name: Sanctuary AI
providers.description: Sanctuary AI is a Vancouver, British Columbia humanoid robotics company on a mission to create and deploy industrial-grade general-purpose humanoid robots to help address growing labor challenges. Its flagship product is Phoenix, a bipedal humanoid robot designed for dull, dirty, and dangerous work in automotive, manufacturing, and logistics environments. Phoenix is driven by Carbon, Sanctuary AI's proprietary AI control system that mimics human cognitive subsystems — memory, sight, sound, and touch — to translate natural-language tasks into dexterous physical actions. The company is vertically integrated, designing everything from motors and actuators through to generative AI algorithms in-house. Co-founded by James Wells (CEO) and Olivia Norton (CTO/CPO), Sanctuary AI has a private GitHub organization with no public repositories, no developer portal, no public API, no SDK, and no published OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications. The commercial model is hardware sales and enterprise deployments; Carbon is a proprietary on-board system and there is no public developer surface.

providers.name: Arrive AI
providers.description: Arrive AI (Nasdaq: ARAI) is an autonomous last-mile delivery company headquartered in Fishers, Indiana, founded by Dan O'Toole and originally operating as DroneDek. Its patented Autonomous Last Mile (ALM) platform is anchored by the Arrive Point, an AI-powered smart mailbox that accepts and dispatches parcels to and from drones, ground robots and human couriers, with temperature-controlled compartments, real-time tracking, smart logistics alerts and chain-of-custody controls aimed at healthcare, pharmacy and e-commerce logistics. The company markets hardware plus a network service; as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings
providers.description: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings is a global airfreight, charter, and aircraft leasing group headquartered in Purchase, New York and operating across more than 80 countries and 330+ airports. The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity). A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

providers.name: Ejen2u
providers.description: Ejen2u is a Malaysian reseller and agent-management technology company that operates one of the country's largest cloud-based reseller ecosystems for MSME brand owners, stockists, agents, dropshippers, and affiliates. Its platform spans EjenGO, a digital reseller and stockist management system; WEMAP, an entrepreneurial education program; and EjenVenture, custom reseller-network solutions for corporate brands, alongside fintech and logistics integrations (Pos Laju, Boost, Curlec, Delyva, J&T). Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seri Kembangan, Ejen2u is backed by 500 Global, Gobi Partners, and Artem Ventures, and has facilitated hundreds of millions of ringgit in reseller commerce across a network of hundreds of thousands of agents. It exposes no public developer API today; this profile is an API Evangelist network entry enriched from public sources.

providers.name: Storyboard
providers.description: Storyboard is a fleet-operations AI platform that gives trucking and logistics companies voice-first, hands-free AI workers for their drivers. The system automates dispatch updates, driver coaching, safety alerts, and compliance monitoring (including hours-of-service and idling) so back-office teams field fewer phone calls and drivers stay hands-free on the road. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, Storyboard began as an enterprise podcast and internal-audio communication platform (a $4.5M seed round led by CRV in 2020) before pivoting to AI-powered fleet operations. It is distributed through in-cab telematics marketplaces such as Platform Science and ISAAC Instruments. Storyboard exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; access is via its web and mobile apps at app.storyboard.com. This profile was surfaced as a CRV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Berkshire Grey
providers.description: Berkshire Grey is a Bedford, Massachusetts-based AI and robotics company that builds integrated pick-and-place, parcel sortation, trailer-unloading, and shuttle-sortation systems for eCommerce fulfillment, retail replenishment, and parcel logistics operations. Its product portfolio is organized around four flagship robotic systems — Core robotic picking system, Dispatch parcel sorter, Scoop trailer unloader, and Stride shuttle sorter — supported by the BG Flex mobile robotic platform and a centralized operating environment that orchestrates fleets of industrial-grade mobile robots for induct, transport, sort, sequence, and fulfill workflows including buy-online-pickup-in-store, curbside, and store replenishment. The company holds 700+ awarded patents (300+ pending) and has deployed solutions with Global-100 retailers and logistics service providers including Walmart, Target, and FedEx, with FedEx expanding from small-parcel sortation into broader AI robotic package-handling capabilities. Berkshire Grey originally went public via SPAC merger with Revolution Acceleration Acquisition Corp in 2021, then entered into a definitive merger agreement with SoftBank Group in 2023 (approximately $375M / $1.40 per share) and is now operated as a private SoftBank portfolio company. Integration with warehouse-management systems is delivered through a proprietary RESTful API surfaced via professional services and a 24/7 remote monitoring and predictive-maintenance support model; the API, BG-OS platform, and any associated SDKs are not publicly documented, and Berkshire Grey does not operate a public developer portal, downloadable SDK, or open-source release for its robotic operating environment.

providers.name: Bounce
providers.description: Bounce operates the world's largest luggage storage network, connecting travelers with more than 32,000 vetted partner locations across 4,000+ cities worldwide where they can securely drop off bags, luggage, and packages by the hour or day and explore hands-free. Founded by Cody Candee in 2018, the company runs a two-sided marketplace: travelers book storage in advance or on the spot through the Bounce web and mobile apps, while local shops, hotels, and businesses earn revenue as storage partners. Bounce also offers luggage-delivery between hotels, airports, and city locations, a hotel solutions program, and an affiliate program. It is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. This profile currently tracks the company's public web surface; Bounce publishes an llms.txt but no public developer API.

providers.name: Dagangan
providers.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Deppon Express
providers.description: Deppon Express (德邦快递), operated by Deppon Logistics Co., Ltd., is a major Chinese express delivery and logistics provider specializing in large-parcel (heavy/bulky) express, less-than-truckload freight, full-truckload, air freight, warehousing, supply chain, and cross-border services. Founded from Cui's Freight Company (1996) and incorporated in 2009, it became part of the JD Logistics group in 2022 and ranks among China's largest express carriers by market share. For developers and enterprise partners, Deppon runs the Deppon Open Platform (德邦开放平台, established 2015) at dpopen.deppon.com, offering system-integration APIs for order creation, standard track/tracking queries, and electronic waybill (面单) printing, with access granted to contracted monthly-settlement customers.

providers.name: Euler Motors
providers.description: Euler Motors is an Indian electric commercial vehicle manufacturer headquartered in New Delhi, building battery-electric cargo and light commercial vehicles for last-mile logistics — the HiLoad and Turbo electric three-wheelers and the Storm EV four-wheeler light commercial vehicle range. Alongside the vehicles the company operates Euler Shepherd, a connected-vehicle telematics platform delivered as two end-user products: Shepherd Lite (a mobile app for real-time vehicle location, battery state of charge, range, charging status and alerts) and Shepherd Enterprise (a browser-based fleet console with trip, utilization and operations reporting). Euler Motors publishes no public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, webhook catalog or partner integration documentation on any host it controls. The Shepherd web console is a single-page application whose backend answers anonymous requests with 403, so the telematics data surface is reachable only to vehicle owners inside the product. The company does publish an llms.txt at its web root, directing AI crawlers to its product, service-network and blog pages.

providers.name: FreightRoll
providers.description: FreightRoll is a logistics technology company whose flagship product, YardOS, is a customizable Yard Operating / Management System (YMS) that turns shipping and receiving yards into driver-friendly, self-service hubs. YardOS reduces truck-driver wait times, improves yard throughput, and streamlines gate and dock operations, with the company citing up to a 50% reduction in truck turnaround time, 95%+ fewer human-to-driver interactions, and $100K+ annual savings per facility across a network of 150,000+ registered drivers. FreightRoll integrates with existing systems across API, EDI, and SFTP mechanisms and deploys remotely in under an hour. The company is backed by 500 Global. FreightRoll does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; its public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access to public site content.

providers.name: Kodiak Robotics
providers.description: Kodiak Robotics, which now operates publicly as Kodiak AI, is an autonomous vehicle company founded in April 2018 by CEO Don Burnette and headquartered in California with a Texas operations center. Its flagship product is the Kodiak Driver, an AI-driven autonomy system that pairs onboard artificial intelligence with modular, swappable sensor hardware and offboard services so that a single driverless stack can be carried across different vehicle platforms. The company sells into three markets — long-haul trucking, defense, and industrial ground transportation — and positions driverless operation as a safety improvement, citing that more than 85% of U.S. truck crashes are caused by human error. Kodiak reports more than 2.6 million autonomous miles driven and over 7,000 loads delivered. Kodiak publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs; enrichment probes of kodiak.ai found no /.well-known/ discovery documents and no api/docs/developer subdomains. It does publish an llms.txt, an RSS news feed, and a corporate safety report, so this profile is maintained as a company record rather than an API producer profile.

providers.name: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd.
